name: Bad Piggies: King Pig's Hunt
storyline:
A mysterious and powerful menace has come to unleash his absolute rage and hunger: The Blackon ! Alongside his evil acolytes: Trox, Redpig and Stormsnout. They're about to create chaos and disaster... and rule over all law with disorder, by taking your entire stock of eggs !

They seek a precious and delicious jewel, the red Eggsteroid, capable of turning any planet and being into eggs. Strangely, (and don't ask how), it's remaining pieces are safely guarded by a bunch of school idols, and they're ready to defend it with the help some old feather foes and powerful guardians.

Don't let them ruin your plans ! Strike them with your ultimate bacon powers and make sure no enemy never return alive !

Get the highest score and eggs as you can, and achieve the King Pig's Hunt !
